edits.before: Q off minions to chip the duo — the angles are the lane and every wave drops souls.
edits.after: Q outranges Starlight's Touch; poke before Dazzle threatens an all-in.

edits.before: Soul discipline begins: collect what's safe; the range grows forever.
edits.after: Dazzle's cooldown is live at this level — trade carefully once it's up.

edits.before: W threats open: any clumped trade risks the spreading root.
edits.after: Bastion's shield starts absorbing your poke, evening the exchange.

edits.before: Dawning Shadow online — the global beam saves dives and finishes recalls.
edits.after: Cosmic Radiance's delayed invulnerability lets him force a fight you can't punish in time.

edits.before: First item: the Q chunks and the soul thresholds start mocking trade math.
edits.after: His shield and heal sustain out-pace your uncontested poke.

edits.before: Late Senna out-ranges the game from the support slot — souls, beams, and mist.
edits.after: Anti-heal and global R out-damage his sustain and punish any commit.

edits.before: - Taric Cosmic Radiance: matchup-defining — The delayed invulnerability erases your teamfight damage — burst before it lands or wait it out. The duo’s tempo bends around it. - Keep E Curse of the Black Mist banked for their best play. - The ultimate is a fight decision, not a habit.
edits.after: Dazzle (E) is down 16s at rank 1, falling to 12s at rank 5 — bait it before stepping up. Cosmic Radiance (R) has a windup before invulnerability, so burst before it lands or wait it out.

edits.before: His engage hunts your pickups — collect behind cover and root the chain that commits.
edits.after: He shields and stuns from close range — outrange Dazzle, poke through Bastion, and burst before Cosmic Radiance's invulnerability lands.

edits.before: Survive the pickup tax and out-range the rest of his game. Cosmic Radiance is the 2v2’s metronome — read it before stepping up.
edits.after: Poke from outside 610 range and force his all-in onto a landed Dazzle, not his R.

edits.before: Taric wins by landing Cosmic Radiance, denying your pattern, and starting one clean chain and letting it pay the whole lane.
edits.after: Taric wins by landing Dazzle to lock down your ADC, then using Cosmic Radiance's delayed invulnerability to force a fight you can't punish.

edits.before: - Senna vs Taric - Track: Taric Cosmic Radiance. - Track his engage cooldown — your duo trades only when it's down. - Cosmic Radiance spent means windows open. - Keep the ult for the swing moment.
edits.after: - Senna vs Taric - Track: Dazzle (E) cooldown — stay outside 610 range when it's up. - Cosmic Radiance has a windup before invulnerability; burst before it resolves. - Bastion's shield eats chip; anti-heal answers Starlight's Touch. - Root punishes any stationary E cast.
